ayahs.ar: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡخَبِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Alhamdu lillaahil lazee lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa lahul hamdu fil aakhirah; wa Huwal Hakeemul Khabeer
ayahs.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنۡزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيۡهَاؕ وَهُوَ الرَّحِيۡمُ الۡغَفُوۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Ya'lamu maa yaliju fil ardi wa maa yakhruju minhaa wa maa yanzilu minas samaaa'i wa maa ya'ruju feehaa; wa Huwar Raheemul Ghafoor
ayahs.en: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَا تَاۡتِيۡنَا السَّاعَةُؕ قُلۡ بَلٰي وَرَبِّيۡ لَتَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡۙ عٰلِمِ الۡغَيۡبِۚ لَا يَعۡزُبُ عَنۡهُ مِثۡقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا٘ اَصۡغَرُ مِنۡ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا٘ اَكۡبَرُ اِلَّا فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo laa taateenas Saa'ah; qul balaa wa Rabbee lataatiyannakum 'Aalimul Ghaib; laa ya'zubu 'anhu misqaalu zarratin fis samaawaati wa laa fil ardi wa laaa asgharu min zaalika wa laaa akbaru illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
ayahs.en: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allah is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

ayahs.ar: لِّيَجۡزِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّرِزۡقٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Liyajziyal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaat; ulaaa'ika lahum maghfiratunw wa rizqun kareem
ayahs.en: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ سَعَوۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيۡنَ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مِّنۡ رِّجۡزٍ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena sa'aw feee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaaa 'ika lahum 'azaabum mir irjzin aleem
ayahs.en: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.

ayahs.ar: وَيَرَي الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ هُوَ الۡحَقَّۙ وَيَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلٰي صِرَاطِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaral lazeena utul 'Ilmal lazeee unzila ilaika mir Rabbika huwal haqqa wa yahdeee ilaaa siraatil 'Azeezil Hameed
ayahs.en: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا هَلۡ نَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ يُّنَبِّئُكُمۡ اِذَا مُزِّقۡتُمۡ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍۙ اِنَّكُمۡ لَفِيۡ خَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo hal nadullukum 'alaa rajuliny yanabbi 'ukum izaa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed
ayahs.en: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?

ayahs.ar: اَفۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَمۡ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌؕ بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ فِي الۡعَذَابِ وَالضَّلٰلِ الۡبَعِيۡدِ
ayahs.tl: Aftaraa 'alal laahi kaziban am bihee jinnah; balil lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati fil'azaabi waddad laalil ba'eed
ayahs.en: Has he invented about Allah a lie or is there in him madness?" Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error.

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلٰي مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نَخۡسِفۡ بِهِمُ الۡاَرۡضَ اَوۡ نُسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبۡدٍ مُّنِيۡبٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Afalam yaraw ilaa maa baina aydeehim wa maa khalfahum minas samaaa'i wal ard; in nashad nakhsif bihimul arda aw nusqit 'alaihim kisafam minas samaaa'; inna fee zaalika la Aayatal likulli 'abdim muneeb
ayahs.en: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ مِنَّا فَضۡلًاؕ يٰجِبَالُ اَوِّبِيۡ مَعَهٗ وَالطَّيۡرَۚ وَاَلَنَّا لَهُ الۡحَدِيۡدَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Daawooda minnaa fadlany yaa jibaalu awwibee ma'ahoo wattaira wa alannaa lahul hadeed
ayahs.en: And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,

ayahs.ar: اَنِ اعۡمَلۡ سٰبِغٰتٍ وَّقَدِّرۡ فِي السَّرۡدِ وَاعۡمَلُوۡا صَالِحًاؕ اِنِّيۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Ani'mal saabighaatinw wa qaddir fis sardi wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.en: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing."

ayahs.ar: وَلِسُلَيۡمٰنَ الرِّيۡحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهۡرٌ وَّرَوَاحُهَا شَهۡرٌۚ وَاَسَلۡنَا لَهٗ عَيۡنَ الۡقِطۡرِؕ وَمِنَ الۡجِنِّ مَنۡ يَّعۡمَلُ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّزِغۡ مِنۡهُمۡ عَنۡ اَمۡرِنَا نُذِقۡهُ مِنۡ عَذَابِ السَّعِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa li-Sulaimaanar reeha ghuduwwuhaa shahrunw wa ra-waahuhaa shahrunw wa asalnaa lahoo 'ainal qitr; wa minal jinni mai ya'malu baina yadaihi bi izni Rabbih; wa mai yazigh minhum 'an amrinaa nuziqhu min 'azaabis sa'eer
ayahs.en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ لَهٗ مَا يَشَآءُ مِنۡ مَّحَارِيۡبَ وَتَمَاثِيۡلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَالۡجَوَابِ وَقُدُوۡرٍ رّٰسِيٰتٍؕ اِعۡمَلُوۡ٘ا اٰلَ دَاوٗدَ شُكۡرًاؕ وَقَلِيۡلٌ مِّنۡ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُوۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Ya'maloona lahoo ma yashaaa'u mim mahaareeba wa tamaaseela wa jifaanin kaljawaabi wa qudoorir raasiyaat; i'maloo aala Daawooda shukraa; wa qaleelum min 'ibaadiyash shakoor
ayahs.en: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. [We said], "Work, O family of David, in gratitude." And few of My servants are grateful.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا قَضَيۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ الۡمَوۡتَ مَا دَلَّهُمۡ عَلٰي مَوۡتِهٖ٘ اِلَّا دَآبَّةُ الۡاَرۡضِ تَاۡكُلُ مِنۡسَاَتَهٗۚ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الۡجِنُّ اَنۡ لَّوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ الۡغَيۡبَ مَا لَبِثُوۡا فِي الۡعَذَابِ الۡمُهِيۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa qadainaa 'alaihil mawta ma dallahum 'alaa mawtiheee illaa daaabbatul ardi taakulu minsa atahoo falammaa kharra tabaiyanatil jinnu al law kaanoo ya'lamoonal ghaiba maa labisoo fil 'azaabil muheen
ayahs.en: And when We decreed for Solomon death, nothing indicated to the jinn his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لِسَبَاٍ فِيۡ مَسۡكَنِهِمۡ اٰيَةٌۚ جَنَّتٰنِ عَنۡ يَّمِيۡنٍ وَّشِمَالٍ ࣢ؕ كُلُوۡا مِنۡ رِّزۡقِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَاشۡكُرُوۡا لَهٗؕ بَلۡدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَّرَبٌّ غَفُوۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Laqad kaana li Saba-in fee maskanihim Aayatun jannataani 'ai yameeninw wa shimaalin kuloo mir rizq Rabbikum washkuroolah; baldatun taiyibatunw wa Rabbun Ghafoor
ayahs.en: There was for [the tribe of] Saba' in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."

ayahs.ar: فَاَعۡرَضُوۡا فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَيۡلَ الۡعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلۡنٰهُمۡ بِجَنَّتَيۡهِمۡ جَنَّتَيۡنِ ذَوَاتَيۡ اُكُلٍ خَمۡطٍ وَّاَثۡلٍ وَّشَيۡءٍ مِّنۡ سِدۡرٍ قَلِيۡلٍ
ayahs.tl: Fa-a''radoo fa-arsalnaa 'alaihim Sailal 'Arimi wa baddalnaahum bijannataihim jannataini azwaatai ukulin khamtinw wa aslinw wa shai'im min sidrin qaleel
ayahs.en: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِمَا كَفَرُوۡاؕ وَهَلۡ نُجٰزِيۡ٘ اِلَّا الۡكَفُوۡرَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika jazainaahum bimaa kafaroo wa hal nujaazeee illal kafoor
ayahs.en: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ الۡقُرَي الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا قُرًي ظَاهِرَةً وَّقَدَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا السَّيۡرَؕ سِيۡرُوۡا فِيۡهَا لَيَالِيَ وَاَيَّامًا اٰمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnaa bainahum wa bainal qural latee baaraknaa feehaa quran zaahiratanw wa qaddamaa feehas sayr; seeroo feehaa la yaalirya wa aiyaaman aamineen
ayahs.en: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed [many] visible cities. And We determined between them the [distances of] journey, [saying], "Travel between them by night or day in safety."

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا بٰعِدۡ بَيۡنَ اَسۡفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَحَادِيۡثَ وَمَزَّقۡنٰهُمۡ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Faqaaloo Rabbanaa baa'id baina asfaarinaa wa zalamooo anfusahum faja'alnaahum ahaadeesa wa mazzaq naahum kulla mumazzaq; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
ayahs.en: But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَدَّقَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اِبۡلِيۡسُ ظَنَّهٗ فَاتَّبَعُوۡهُ اِلَّا فَرِيۡقًا مِّنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad saddaq 'alaihim Ibleesu zannnabhoo fattaba'oohu illaa fareeqam minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهٗ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍ اِلَّا لِنَعۡلَمَ مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ مِنۡهَا فِيۡ شَكٍّؕ وَرَبُّكَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيۡظٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana lahoo 'alaihim min sultaanin illaa lina'lama mai yu minu bil Aakhirati mimman huwa minhaa fee shakk; wa Rabbuka 'alaa kulli shai'in Hafeez
ayahs.en: And he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.

ayahs.ar: قُلِ ادۡعُوا الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا لَهُمۡ فِيۡهِمَا مِنۡ شِرۡكٍ وَّمَا لَهٗ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ ظَهِيۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Qulid 'ul lazeena za'amtum min doonil laahi laa yamlikoona misqaala zarratin fissamaawaati wa laa fil ardi wa maa lahum feehimaa min shirkinw wa maa lahoo minhum min zaheer
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allah." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَنۡفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنۡدَهٗ٘ اِلَّا لِمَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهٗؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ قَالُوۡا مَاذَاۙ قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡؕ قَالُوا الۡحَقَّۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَلِيُّ الۡكَبِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tanfa'ush shafaa'atu 'indahooo illaa liman azina lah; hattaaa izaa fuzzi'a 'an quloobihim qaaloo maazaa qaala Rabbukum; qaalul haqq, wa Huwal 'Aliyul Kabeer
ayahs.en: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts, they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ يَّرۡزُقُكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُۙ وَاِنَّا٘ اَوۡ اِيَّاكُمۡ لَعَلٰي هُدًي اَوۡ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul mai yarzuqukum minas samaawaati wal ardi qulil laahu wa innaaa aw iyyaakum la'alaa hudan aw fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allah. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّا تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ عَمَّا٘ اَجۡرَمۡنَا وَلَا نُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul laa tus'aloona 'ammaaa ajramnaa wa laa nus'alu 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفۡتَحُ بَيۡنَنَا بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَهُوَ الۡفَتَّاحُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qul yajma'u bainanaa Rabbunaa summa yaftahu bainanaa bilhaqq; wa Huwal Fattaahul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرُوۡنِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَلۡحَقۡتُمۡ بِهٖ شُرَكَآءَ كَلَّاؕ بَلۡ هُوَ اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qul arooniyal lazeena alhaqtum bihee shurakaaa'a kallaa; bal Huwal Laahul 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيۡرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًا وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaaka illaa kaaffatal linnaasi basheeranw wa nazeeranw wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّكُمۡ مِّيۡعَادُ يَوۡمٍ لَّا تَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ عَنۡهُ سَاعَةً وَّلَا تَسۡتَقۡدِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul lakum mee'aadu Yawmil laa tastaakhiroona 'anhu saa'atanw wa la tastaqdimoon
ayahs.en: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡمِنَ بِهٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَلَا بِالَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡ تَرٰ٘ي اِذِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ مَوۡقُوۡفُوۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡۚۖ يَرۡجِعُ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اِلٰي بَعۡضِ اِۨلۡقَوۡلَۚ يَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَكُنَّا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihaazal Quraani wa laa billazee baina yadayh; wa law taraaa iziz zaalimoona mawqoofoona 'inda Rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ilaa ba'dinil qawla yaqoolul lazeenas tud'ifoo lillazeenas takbaroo law laaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur'an nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each other's words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡ٘ا اَنَحۡنُ صَدَدۡنٰكُمۡ عَنِ الۡهُدٰي بَعۡدَ اِذۡ جَآءَكُمۡ بَلۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal lazeenas takbaroo lillazeenas tud'ifooo anahnu sadadnaakum 'anil hudaa ba'da iz jaaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen
ayahs.en: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا بَلۡ مَكۡرُ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ اِذۡ تَاۡمُرُوۡنَنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّكۡفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَنَجۡعَلَ لَهٗ٘ اَنۡدَادًاؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا الۡاَغۡلٰلَ فِيۡ٘ اَعۡنَاقِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاؕ هَلۡ يُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeenastud'ifoo lillazeenas takbaroo bal makrul laili wannahaari iz taamuroonanaaa an nakfura billaahi wa naj'ala lahooo andaadaa; wa asarrun nadaamata lammaa ra awul 'azaab; wa ja'alnal aghlaala feee a'naaqil lazeena kafaroo; hal yujzawna illaa maa kanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allah and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَا٘ اِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa' fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafooaa innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.en: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اَكۡثَرُ اَمۡوَالًا وَّاَوۡلَادًاۙ وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo nahnu aksaru amwaalanw wa awlaadanw wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen
ayahs.en: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul inna Rabbee yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u wa yaqdiru wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَمۡوَالُكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَوۡلَادُكُمۡ بِالَّتِيۡ تُقَرِّبُكُمۡ عِنۡدَنَا زُلۡفٰ٘ي اِلَّا مَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًاؗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءُ الضِّعۡفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوۡا وَهُمۡ فِي الۡغُرُفٰتِ اٰمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa amwaalukum wa laaa awlaadukum billatee tuqarribukum 'indanaa zulfaaa illaa man aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika lahum jazaaa'ud di'fi bimaa 'amiloo wa hum fil ghurufaati aaminoon
ayahs.en: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡعَوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيۡنَ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yas'awna feee Aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaaa'ika fil'azaabi muhdaroon
ayahs.en: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهٗؕ وَمَا٘ اَنۡفَقۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَهُوَ يُخۡلِفُهٗۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰزِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul inna Rabbee yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee wa yaqdiru lah; wa maaa anfaqtum min shai'in fahuwa yukhlifuhoo wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ يَقُوۡلُ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اَهٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اِيَّاكُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yawma yahshuruhum jamee'an summa yaqoolu lilmalaaa'ikati a-haaa'ulaaa'i iyyaakum kaanoo ya'budoon
ayahs.en: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَكَ اَنۡتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمۡۚ بَلۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ الۡجِنَّۚ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ بِهِمۡ مُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo Subhaanaka Anta waliyyunaa min doonihim bal kaanoo ya'budoonal jinna aksaruhum bihim mu'minoon
ayahs.en: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allah], are our benefactor not them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."

ayahs.ar: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا يَمۡلِكُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ نَّفۡعًا وَّلَا ضَرًّاؕ وَنَقُوۡلُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fal Yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'anw wa laa darraa; wa naqoolu lilzeena zalamoo zooqoo 'azaaban Naaril latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon
ayahs.en: But today you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالُوۡا مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّصُدَّكُمۡ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُكُمۡۚ وَقَالُوۡا مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اِفۡكٌ مُّفۡتَرًيؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۙ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaaloo maa haazaa illaa rajuluny yureedu ai-yasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaaa'ukum wa qaaloo maa haazaaa illaaa ifkum muftaraa; wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum in haazaaa illaa sihrum mubeen
ayahs.en: And when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ كُتُبٍ يَّدۡرُسُوۡنَهَا وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَبۡلَكَ مِنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa aatainaahum min Kutubiny yadrusoonahaa wa maaa arsalnaaa ilaihim qablaka min nazeer
ayahs.en: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muhammad], any warner.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡۙ وَمَا بَلَغُوۡا مِعۡشَارَ مَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَكَذَّبُوۡا رُسُلِيۡࣞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيۡرِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa kazzabal lazeena min qablihim wa maa balaghoo mi'shaara maaa aatainaahum fakazzaboo Rusulee; fakaifa kaana nakeer
ayahs.en: And those before them denied, and the people of Makkah have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But the former peoples denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَعِظُكُمۡ بِوَاحِدَةٍۚ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمُوۡا لِلّٰهِ مَثۡنٰي وَفُرَادٰي ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوۡاࣞ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُمۡ مِّنۡ جِنَّةٍؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا نَذِيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaaa a'izukum biwaahidatin an taqoomoo lillaahi masnaa wa furaadaa summa tatafakkaroo; maa bisaahibikum min jinnah; in huwa illaa nazeerul lakum baina yadai 'azaabin shadeed
ayahs.en: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allah, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَا سَاَلۡتُكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَجۡرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمۡؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Qul maa sa-altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illaa 'alal laahi wa Huwa 'alaa kullin shai-in Shaheed
ayahs.en: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allah, and He is, over all things, Witness."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ يَقۡذِفُ بِالۡحَقِّۚ عَلَّامُ الۡغُيُوۡبِ
ayahs.tl: Qul inna Rabbee yaqzifu bilhaqq 'Allaamul Ghuyoob
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth. Knower of the unseen."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ جَآءَ الۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ الۡبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Qul jaaa'al haqqu wa maa yubdi'ul baatilu wa maa yu'eed
ayahs.en: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ ضَلَلۡتُ فَاِنَّمَا٘ اَضِلُّ عَلٰي نَفۡسِيۡۚ وَاِنِ اهۡتَدَيۡتُ فَبِمَا يُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيَّ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ سَمِيۡعٌ قَرِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Qul in dalaltu fainnamaaa adillu 'alaa nafsee wa inih-tadaitu fabimaa yoohee ilaiya Rabbee; innahoo Samee'un Qareeb
ayahs.en: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ تَرٰ٘ي اِذۡ فَزِعُوۡا فَلَا فَوۡتَ وَاُخِذُوۡا مِنۡ مَّكَانٍ قَرِيۡبٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law taraaa iz fazi'oo falaa fawta wa ukhizoo mim makaanin qareeb
ayahs.en: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.

ayahs.ar: وَّقَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۚ وَاَنّٰي لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaloo aamannaa bihee wa annaa lahumut tanaawushu mim makaanim ba'eed
ayahs.en: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?

ayahs.ar: وَقَدۡ كَفَرُوۡا بِهٖ مِنۡ قَبۡلُۚ وَيَقۡذِفُوۡنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa qad kafaroo bihee min qablu wa yaqzifoona bilghaibi mim makaanim ba'eed
ayahs.en: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.

ayahs.ar: وَحِيۡلَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ مَا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِاَشۡيَاعِهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا فِيۡ شَكٍّ مُّرِيۡبٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa heela bainahum wa baina maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'ila bi-ashyaa'ihim min qabl; innahum kaanoo fee shakkim mureeb
ayahs.en: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting denial.
